couplets.en: Touch my song with your lips and let it live forever.

lines: Hothon se chhu lo tum, mera geet amar kar do
couplets.en: Touch my song with your lips and let it live, let it live forever.
Touch my song with your lips and let it live forever.
Be my beloved and let my love live forever.
Touch my song with your lips and let it live forever.
Let age set no bounds and birth lay no claim.
Let age set no bounds and birth lay no claim.

lines: Jab pyaar kare koi, to dekhe keval man
Nayi reet chala kar tum, yeh reet amar kar do, yeh reet amar kar do, mera geet amar kar do
couplets.en: Let lovers see only the heart, and let this new way of loving live forever with my song.
The emptiness of the sky lies within my lonely heart.
The emptiness of the sky lies within my lonely heart.

lines: Paayal chhankaati tum, aa jao jeevan mein
Saansein dekar apni, sangeet amar kar do
couplets.en: Come into my life with your anklets ringing, and give the music your breath so it may live forever.
Let the music live forever, let my song live forever.
